validation.paper_vs_uci_note: Official UCI HTRU2 has 17898 rows with 0 missing values. The 2023 IEEE paper used a Kaggle train split of 12528 rows (~70%) with ~3.1% artificially injected missing values imputed via MICE.

dataset_distinction.paper: Kaggle train split 12,528 rows (~70%), ~3.1% missing + MICE
dataset_distinction.pos_label_note: Paper caret tables used Positive Class : 0 (non-pulsar). We log both pos_label=1 (proposal) and pos_label=0 (paper-aligned).
